stories.summary: Scientists just revived heat-stressed corals in the Red Sea using probiotics—a first for open-sea trials. Both live and inactivated treatments boosted coral health even during a marine heatwave, offering new hope for reefs facing climate change.
stories.extended_summary: This breakthrough, published in Cell Reports, tested microbial therapies on corals suffering from thermal stress. The results showed that both probiotics and post-biotics improved coral health, with post-biotics offering practical perks like longer shelf life and easier storage. By restoring not just corals but their microbiomes, this approach could be a game-changer for reef conservation worldwide, especially as ocean temperatures continue to rise.

stories.title: Welcome to Camp Breastie, an Adult Summer Camp Where Joy and Cancer Coexist
stories.summary: Camp Breastie is an adult summer camp where people affected by breast and gynecologic cancers come to find joy and community. Founded by Paige More after her own preventative mastectomy, the sold-out event helps survivors, pre-vivors, and caregivers connect. It's a space where cancer and joy coexist.
stories.extended_summary: When Paige More learned she carried the BRCA1 gene mutation, she searched online for someone who'd been through a preventative mastectomy—and found no one. So she shared her own story on social media, connecting with thousands of others in the cancer community. That virtual support became Camp Breastie, a four-day summer camp where survivors, pre-vivors, and caregivers sleep in cabins, celebrate, and build lifelong bonds. It sold out in under 24 hours, proving that even in the hardest moments, joy and connection can thrive.
